request.system:
You check whether short claims are faithful to the source texts they cite.

The claims form one answer and are read together: a condition or exception stated in another claim does not need to be repeated, and a claim that summarises part of a text is faithful if that part is accurate. Mark a claim unfaithful only when it asserts something the cited texts contradict or do not support.

For each claim, answer: does the claim follow from the cited texts alone, without adding, narrowing, or changing anything they say? A claim that paraphrases or restates accurately is faithful — identical wording is not required. A claim that introduces a number, condition, or conclusion the texts do not support is not. Each cited text is labelled with its reference (e.g. "3.A.6") and title; a claim may use that label. Judge only the substance of the claim against its texts; ignore whether it answers any particular question and ignore framing about what a text is or is not about. Give a one-sentence reason.
request.user:
Claim 0: Under 3.A.6, a new portfolio must be included in a composite no later than the beginning of the first full calendar month after it comes under management.
  Cited texts:
    [prov:composite-inclusion-timing@E2025] 3.A.6 Timing of new portfolio inclusion: New portfolios must be included in a composite on a timely and consistent basis, and no later than the beginning of the first full calendar month after the portfolio comes under management. Firms must document the inclusion date applied for each composite.

Claim 1: Under 3.A.6, inclusion must also be on a timely and consistent basis.
  Cited texts:
    [prov:composite-inclusion-timing@E2025] 3.A.6 Timing of new portfolio inclusion: New portfolios must be included in a composite on a timely and consistent basis, and no later than the beginning of the first full calendar month after the portfolio comes under management. Firms must document the inclusion date applied for each composite.

Claim 2: Under 3.A.6, firms must document the inclusion date applied for each composite.
  Cited texts:
    [prov:composite-inclusion-timing@E2025] 3.A.6 Timing of new portfolio inclusion: New portfolios must be included in a composite on a timely and consistent basis, and no later than the beginning of the first full calendar month after the portfolio comes under management. Firms must document the inclusion date applied for each composite.

Claim 3: Under 1.D.1, a composite is an aggregation of one or more portfolios managed according to a similar investment mandate, objective, or strategy.
  Cited texts:
    [def:composite@E2025] 1.D.1 Composite: A composite is an aggregation of one or more portfolios managed according to a similar investment mandate, objective, or strategy.

verdicts.reason: The text requires inclusion no later than the beginning of the first full calendar month after the portfolio comes under management, as the claim states.
The text says new portfolios must be included on a timely and consistent basis.
The text states firms must document the inclusion date applied for each composite.
The definition in 1.D.1 matches the claim's wording and substance exactly.
